C1605.title: CVE-2024-48989: Recent Profinet Protocol Vulnerability
C1605.summary: NVD contains a CVE-2024-48989 record, but the current source does not provide enough vulnerability description to confirm whether it is a Profinet-related vulnerability, its impact scope, attack conditions, or consequences. The entry can currently only serve as a case of the vulnerability record existing; claims about unauthorized operation risks in industrial control systems require CVE official descriptions, vendor advisories, or vulnerability database sources.
